Title: Azure Dav4-series VMs are available in Azure HDInsight

Body.Content:
Azure Dav4-series, featuring the latest AMD EPYC™ 7452 processor and Das v4-series with Premium SSD disk storage, are available in Azure HDInsight. Dav4-series provide up to 96 vCPUs, 384 GiBs of RAM and 2,400 GiBs of SSD-based temporary storage.

The Dav4-series and Das v4-series are well suited for general purpose workloads. They offer great performance at competitive price points and can run enterprise-grade big data analytics.

Dav4-series and Das v4-series instances are available in many regions in US, Europe, Asia etc. You can build Hadoop, Spark, Hive, interactive query (LLAP), Kafka, and HBase solutions with Dav4-series. You can also use premium storage of Das v4-series for Kafka and HBase solutions. 

Please refer to HDInsight pricing page for price detals. 

Learn more.
